summary: READY_FOR_REVIEW for the documentation-only M1 HTTPS/TLS architecture revision. ADR 0011 and the normative transport contract now cover all three outbound clients, callback/Grafana 443-only ALB/ACM ingress, private ECS targets, TLS ownership and immutability, custom CA handling, bounded failure metadata, secret exclusion, downgrade prevention, local synthetic HTTP isolation, and future mTLS extension. Documentation/static checks, Gradle project discovery, build, tests, and the implemented M2 core security gate pass. Aggregate verification remains intentionally non-zero because downstream Alloy/Loki/Grafana security and exact M9 performance/TLS evidence are NOT IMPLEMENTED; no runtime transport-readiness claim is made.
nextActions: Review ADR 0011, especially the 443-only/no-port-80 decision, ALB termination boundary, callback-ALB ownership, and custom CA policy.
Add M3 synthetic TLS and client-configuration immutability evidence without changing host TLS behavior.
Implement and validate the M8 ALB/ACM/private-target Terraform controls and M9 downgrade, rotation, secret-leak, and direct-access tests before any transport-readiness claim.
